correctness.rationale: Each four-cycle is uniquely internal to one child or uses exactly two top matching edges, giving the overlap decomposition. A complete ordered-edge-pair count proves universal conditional mean and variance, including exceptional deterministic dimension two; symbolic fraction algebra was checked. Conditional centering makes increments at nested nodes orthogonal, yielding exact finite variance. A fixed-bottom-level i.i.d. CLT and a uniform summable high-level variance bound establish the Gaussian limit; Borel–Cantelli establishes concentration. The trace identity counts non-cycle closed walks, plus eight per simple square. The executable verification enumerated 161,304 top matching configurations and 140 sampled direct cycle identities; finite checks do not replace the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The number of four-cycles is a canonical obstruction to local tree-likeness specifically emphasized in the earlier twisted-hypercube spectral study. The full all-dimensional moments and nondegenerate Gaussian fluctuations quantitatively characterize the extensive square population and fourth-trace stochastic fluctuations that weak semicircle convergence leaves unresolved. The closed variance constant and fixed-depth iid approximation furnish a structurally reusable method beyond routine small-graph enumeration.
